criteria.requirement: Add Job.set_priority(priority) accepting nonboolean integers, returning self. Scheduler.run_pending must order due jobs first by existing next_run, then descending explicit priority (default zero), then stable registration order for ties. Earlier due times always win over priority. Preserve due-set snapshot, CancelJob semantics, exception propagation, Job.__lt__, run_all order and behavior of unconfigured jobs.
